types.SM.openTreeRec_one:
SM.openTreeRec_one.{u} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
  (ordinary : (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) → SM.IntervalComposition I → R) (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n)
  (hI : I.leaves = 1) : SM.openTreeRec ordinary I = 1
types.SM.openTreeRec_many:
SM.openTreeRec_many.{u} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
  (ordinary : (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) → SM.IntervalComposition I → R) (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n)
  (hI : 2 ≤ I.leaves) : SM.openTreeRec ordinary I = -∑ π, ordinary I ↑π * ∏ k, SM.openTreeRec ordinary ((↑π).part k)

types.SM.openTreeSum_one:
SM.openTreeSum_one {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (hP : SM.G1 P) (g : ZMod n) (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n)
  (hI : I.leaves = 1) : SM.openTreeSum P hP g I = 1
types.SM.openTreeSum_many:
SM.openTreeSum_many {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (hP : SM.G1 P) (g : ZMod n) (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n)
  (hI : 2 ≤ I.leaves) :
  SM.openTreeSum P hP g I = -∑ π, (↑π).ordinaryWeight P hP g * ∏ k, SM.openTreeSum P hP g ((↑π).part k)
types.SM.treeCoefficient_eq:
SM.treeCoefficient_eq {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (hP : SM.G1 P) (g : ZMod n) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
  SM.treeCoefficient P hP g hn = ∑ π, π.rootWeight P hP g * ∏ k, SM.openTreeSum P hP g (π.part k)

types.SM.IntervalComposition.nearSign_eq_of_ch:
SM.IntervalComposition.nearSign_eq_of_chi {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {I : SM.BoundaryInterval n} (π : SM.IntervalComposition I)
  {P Q : SM.LabelledTuple n} (hchi : ∀ (i j k : ZMod n), SM.chi P i j k = SM.chi Q i j k) (g : ZMod n)
  (k : Fin (π.parts - 1)) : π.nearSign P g k = π.nearSign Q g k
types.SM.IntervalComposition.farSign_eq_of_chi:
SM.IntervalComposition.farSign_eq_of_chi {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {I : SM.BoundaryInterval n} (π : SM.IntervalComposition I)

types.SM.IntervalComposition.ordinaryWeight_eq:
SM.IntervalComposition.ordinaryWeight_eq_of_chi {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {I : SM.BoundaryInterval n}
  (π : SM.IntervalComposition I) {P Q : SM.LabelledTuple n} (hP : SM.G1 P) (hQ : SM.G1 Q)
  (hchi : ∀ (i j k : ZMod n), SM.chi P i j k = SM.chi Q i j k) (g : ZMod n) :
  π.ordinaryWeight P hP g = π.ordinaryWeight Q hQ g
types.SM.openTreeSum_eq_of_chi:
SM.openTreeSum_eq_of_chi {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {P Q : SM.LabelledTuple n} (hP : SM.G1 P) (hQ : SM.G1 Q)
  (hchi : ∀ (i j k : ZMod n), SM.chi P i j k = SM.chi Q i j k) (g : ZMod n) (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) :
  SM.openTreeSum P hP g I = SM.openTreeSum Q hQ g I
types.SM.treeCoefficient_eq_of_chi:
SM.treeCoefficient_eq_of_chi {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {P Q : SM.LabelledTuple n} (hP : SM.G1 P) (hQ : SM.G1 Q)
  (hchi : ∀ (i j k : ZMod n), SM.chi P i j k = SM.chi Q i j k) (g : ZMod n) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
  SM.treeCoefficient P hP g hn = SM.treeCoefficient Q hQ g hn
types.SM.openTreeSum_shift:
SM.openTreeSum_shift {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (hP : SM.G1 P) (g a : ZMod n)
  (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) : SM.openTreeSum (SM.shift a P) ⋯ (g - a) I = SM.openTreeSum P hP g I
types.SM.treeCoefficient_shift:
SM.treeCoefficient_shift {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (hP : SM.G1 P) (g a : ZMod n) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
  SM.treeCoefficient (SM.shift a P) ⋯ (g - a) hn = SM.treeCoefficient P hP g hn
types.SM.mainTreeCoefficient_shift:
SM.mainTreeCoefficient_shift {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (hP : SM.G1 P) (a : ZMod n) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
  SM.mainTreeCoefficient (SM.shift a P) ⋯ hn = SM.treeCoefficient P hP a hn
types.SM.treesumData_shift:
SM.treesumData_shift {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (hP : SM.G1 P) (g a : ZMod n) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
  SM.treesumData (SM.shift a P) ⋯ (g - a) hn =
    (SM.openTreeSum P hP g, SM.treeCoefficient P hP g hn, SM.treeCoefficient P hP a hn)
types.SM.tree_data_eq_of_chi:
SM.tree_data_eq_of_chi {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {P Q : SM.LabelledTuple n} (hP : SM.G1 P) (hQ : SM.G1 Q)
  (hchi : ∀ (i j k : ZMod n), SM.chi P i j k = SM.chi Q i j k) (g : ZMod n) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
  (∀ (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) (π : SM.IntervalComposition I),
      π.ordinaryWeight P hP g = π.ordinaryWeight Q hQ g ∧ π.rootWeight P hP g = π.rootWeight Q hQ g) ∧
    (∀ (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n), SM.openTreeSum P hP g I = SM.openTreeSum Q hQ g I) ∧
      SM.treeCoefficient P hP g hn = SM.treeCoefficient Q hQ g hn
types.SM.labelled_chamber_chi_constant:
SM.labelled_chamber_chi_constant {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P Q : SM.GenericTuple n) (hQ : Q ∈ SM.labelledChamber P)
  (i j k : ZMod n) : SM.chi (↑P) i j k = SM.chi (↑Q) i j k
types.SM.tree_data_labelled_chamber_constant:
SM.tree_data_labelled_chamber_constant {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P Q : SM.GenericTuple n) (hQ : Q ∈ SM.labelledChamber P)
  (g : ZMod n) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
  (∀ (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) (π : SM.IntervalComposition I),
      π.ordinaryWeight ↑P ⋯ g = π.ordinaryWeight ↑Q ⋯ g ∧ π.rootWeight ↑P ⋯ g = π.rootWeight ↑Q ⋯ g) ∧
    (∀ (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n), SM.openTreeSum ↑P ⋯ g I = SM.openTreeSum ↑Q ⋯ g I) ∧
      SM.treeCoefficient ↑P ⋯ g hn = SM.treeCoefficient ↑Q ⋯ g hn
types.SM.tree_data_G1_path_constant:
SM.tree_data_G1_path_constant {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {P Q : { P // SM.G1 P }} (γ : Path P Q)
  (hchi : ∀ (s t : ↑unitInterval) (i j k : ZMod n), SM.chi (↑(γ s)) i j k = SM.chi (↑(γ t)) i j k) (g : ZMod n)
  (hn : 3 ≤ n) (s t : ↑unitInterval) :
  (∀ (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) (π : SM.IntervalComposition I),
      π.ordinaryWeight ↑(γ s) ⋯ g = π.ordinaryWeight ↑(γ t) ⋯ g ∧ π.rootWeight ↑(γ s) ⋯ g = π.rootWeight ↑(γ t) ⋯ g) ∧
    (∀ (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n), SM.openTreeSum ↑(γ s) ⋯ g I = SM.openTreeSum ↑(γ t) ⋯ g I) ∧
      SM.treeCoefficient ↑(γ s) ⋯ g hn = SM.treeCoefficient ↑(γ t) ⋯ g hn
types.SM.treeCoefficient_quotient_chamber_tran:
SM.treeCoefficient_quotient_chamber_transport {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P Q : SM.GenericTuple n) (hn : 3 ≤ n)
  (hQ : SM.polygonProjection Q ∈ SM.chamber (SM.polygonProjection P)) :
  ∃ a,
    Q ∈ SM.labelledChamber (SM.genericShift a P) ∧
      ∀ (g : ZMod n), SM.treeCoefficient ↑Q ⋯ (g - a) hn = SM.treeCoefficient ↑P ⋯ g hn
types.SM.TreeDataEqual:
SM.TreeDataEqual {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P Q : SM.LabelledTuple n) (hP : SM.G1 P) (hQ : SM.G1 Q) (g : ZMod n) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
  Prop
types.SM.A_chamber:
SM.A_chamber {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
  (∀ (P Q : SM.LabelledTuple n) (hP : SM.G1 P) (hQ : SM.G1 Q),
      (∀ (i j k : ZMod n), SM.chi P i j k = SM.chi Q i j k) → ∀ (g : ZMod n), SM.TreeDataEqual P Q hP hQ g hn) ∧
    (∀ (P Q : SM.GenericTuple n), Q ∈ SM.labelledChamber P → ∀ (g : ZMod n), SM.TreeDataEqual ↑P ↑Q ⋯ ⋯ g hn) ∧
      (∀ (P Q : SM.GenericTuple n),
          SM.polygonProjection Q ∈ SM.chamber (SM.polygonProjection P) →
            ∃ a,
              Q ∈ SM.labelledChamber (SM.genericShift a P) ∧
                ∀ (g : ZMod n), SM.treeCoefficient ↑Q ⋯ (g - a) hn = SM.treeCoefficient ↑P ⋯ g hn) ∧
        ∀ (P Q : { P // SM.G1 P }) (γ : Path P Q),
          (∀ (s t : ↑unitInterval) (i j k : ZMod n), SM.chi (↑(γ s)) i j k = SM.chi (↑(γ t)) i j k) →
            ∀ (g : ZMod n) (s t : ↑unitInterval), SM.TreeDataEqual ↑(γ s) ↑(γ t) ⋯ ⋯ g hn
